messages.subject: UAE/GCC Executive Profile | Energy, Natural Resources, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Dutta,

I am sharing my profile for senior and confidential leadership mandates across the UAE, Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC. Your leadership of EMA Partners UAE and your work across Industrial, Manufacturing, Energy & Natural Resources and senior leadership appointments make this a particularly relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, social performance and executive advisory within a major gold-mining and infrastructure environment.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director or Representative, Executive Director and VP-track appointments. My strongest fit is where country leadership intersects with government relations, ESG, strategic partnerships, natural resources, energy transition, infrastructure and complex regulated operations.

I am internationally mobile, open to expatriate and residential assignments, and available on 30 days' notice. My GCC-focused executive CV is attached for consideration across suitable current or confidential searches.

Preferred reply address: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

https://www.linkedin.com/in/ragunauth-ramsaroop/
